decisions.reason: Because this software extends the firm's established oncology QA business and its announced push toward integration and automation, management is likely to justify continued support and treat any weak uptake as still temporary.
Because this CT phantom is close to the firm's existing imaging and QA capabilities, the investment is easy to defend and there is little pressure to withdraw it after only an initial market year.

Because this mammography phantom is more distant from the core offer its strategic protection is weaker, but after a recent launch management would still be inclined to give the product more time rather than admit a premature expansion error.

Because this full field mammography phantom also sits relatively far from the firm's main radiation therapy base, withdrawal risk is higher, yet sunk launch effort and the ability to blame slow adoption on early market development still favor retention for now.
Because this imaging QA instrument line is a visible flagship tied to the firm's stated direction, management is strongly committed and would be very reluctant to reverse course within the next year.
